verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same: the suitcase is on the left without its pale circle backdrop, the logo is demoted to the bottom-left corner under the suitcase's wheels, and the legal block is shrunk to unreadable micro-type. A is worse because the headline 'Fly now,' is jammed against the top edge with almost no margin, so the top-right feels cramped while the space below the legal text is loose. B gives the headline proper top breathing room and spaces the headline, subhead and CTA more evenly, but it still has the buried logo, the suitcase crowding the left edge and illegible fine print.
